text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: orientation is tomorrow 9:00 AM PT / 5:00 PM GMT. I sent invites to everyone on the new-hires group. Zoom link + agenda in the event.
Ravi: Thanks! Is that the session with platform walkthrough + account setup?
Maya (People Ops): Yep 3: intros, access checklist, security quickstart, benefits Q&A. We'll record and add captions.
Chen: I
m in HKT so joining live is late. Will the APAC replay be available?
Maya (People Ops): Yes. We'll run an APAC-friendly replay next Tuesday at 8:30 AM PT / 1:30 AM HKT (Wednesday). Recording + notes go to Notion and attached to the calendar event.
Sophie: Can you add the onboarding buddy to the calendar description? Makes it easier to find who to ping after the session.
Maya (People Ops): Good idea. I'll paste buddy names and emails in the description.
IT-bot: Reminder: new hires must complete MFA setup before the orientation to avoid access delays. Setup guide: https://intranet.company.com/it/mfa.
Ravi: Small ask 3 can the calendar event include timezone conversions? My calendar sometimes shows odd offsets.
Maya (People Ops): We used the company calendar's timezone conversion. If anyone sees a mismatch, DM me and I'll send a separate invite in your local TZ.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: "New Hire Orientation 3 Cohort Jan" on 2025-02-07 09:00:00 PT. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210. Recording: will be posted to https://drive.company.com/orientation-recordings. Invite: new-hires@redwood.com
Chen: Will the recording have captions or a transcript? My connection is flaky and captions help.
Maya (People Ops): We'll enable Zoom auto-captions and upload a time-stamped transcript to Notion. If auto-captions are missing, we'll add a manual transcript.
Sophie: Also can we have the recording split into sections (access setup / benefits / security)? Makes rewatching faster.
Maya (People Ops): Good request. We'll add timestamps in the Notion page and in the calendar description.
Ravi: Who should I ping if I can't get into Zoom during the meeting?
Maya (People Ops): Ping your onboarding buddy (listed in the event) or @IT-support on Slack. If it's urgent, DM me and I'll loop in IT.
IT-bot: If you need a calendar .ics file for other clients, reply with `ics me` and I'll attach one.
Sophie: Maya, will the APAC-friendly replay be a live second session or just a posted recording?
Maya (People Ops): We'll run a live replay session with a short live Q&A so APAC folks can ask questions in a timezone-friendly slot. I'll mark it "APAC-friendly" and invite the same group.
Chen: Thanks, that helps a lot. One more 3 can you add links to the pre-reads in the calendar so they show up in mobile notifications?
Maya (People Ops): Yep, pre-reads are in the event description. They'll also be on the Notion pre-reads page: https://notion.so/redwood/onboarding.
Ravi: Sounds good. I'll try to finish MFA before the session.
Maya (People Ops): Reminder: I'll post the APAC event link in this thread once it's created. If you don't get the invites, DM me. See you all tomorrow (or at the replay)! :wave:
